prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent currency icon for Sylve, a polished fantasy forest collectible card game.
Primary request: Create one small readable "friendship help token" currency icon, a warm honey-gold round medallion featuring two clasped hands embossed at its center and a subtle emerald-green leaf on its rim.
Style/medium: richly painted fantasy game inventory item, softly shaded dimensional metal, elegant gold and dark forest-green enamel, crisp silhouette and generous transparent margins. The game's existing friends icon shows two clasped leather-gloved hands with green and gold cuffs.
Composition/framing: single isolated coin in a slight three-quarter view, centered, fills about 80% of a square canvas, recognizable at 24 pixels.
Lighting/mood: warm magical highlights, gentle depth, welcoming.
Constraints: genuinely transparent background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no scene, no surrounding objects, no UI panel, no glow outside the coin silhouette.
